legal.privacySummary: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
legal.termsSummary: The rights and responsibilities you should understand before using LinLinQi.
legal.scopeBody: This policy applies to the LinLinQi store, account center, reseller console, and open APIs. Individual products may carry additional licensing or regional rules.
legal.tradeBody: Orders reserve inventory on creation; delivery completes automatically after payment. Valid digital entitlements already shown or sent generally cannot be returned without cause unless explicitly agreed for the product.
legal.securityBody: Sensitive delivery content is stored encrypted. Sign-in, lookup, payment, export, and other operations generate necessary security logs for risk control, audit, and dispute handling.

console.settlementRuleExplanation: The platform settlement discount is used to compute the platform settlement price and distribution profit for new orders; it does not automatically lower the customer-facing price. Customer prices continue to be decided by the product rules below and always stay above the public platform price floor.
